sql_calls.sql:
SELECT 'daily_sales' AS source, date::text AS day, units_sold::text AS value1, revenue_inr::text AS value2, NULL::text AS extra
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', date::text, book_on_hand_close::text, NULL, NULL
FROM store.inventory_book
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', audit_ts::text, status, NULL, NULL
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', date::text, forecast_units_per_day::text, sigma::text,
       'reorder=' || reorder_point || ',order_up_to=' || order_up_to || ',book=' || book_on_hand || ',on_order=' || on_order || ',ordered=' || ordered_units
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY source, day;

SELECT audit_ts, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

WITH june_lines AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM store.pos_lines
    WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
      AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
      AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales
     WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_units,
    (SELECT SUM(revenue_inr) FROM store.daily_sales
     WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_revenue,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.daily_sales
     WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS daily_sales_rows,
    (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS first_sales_date,
    (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS last_sales_date,
    (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM june_lines) AS pos_units,
    (SELECT SUM(line_amount) FROM june_lines) AS pos_revenue,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM june_lines) AS bills_with_atta,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM june_lines) AS pos_lines,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
     WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS june_audits,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits
     WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status = 'on shelf'
       AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS on_shelf_audits;

SELECT 'inventory_book' AS source, date::text AS ts, book_on_hand_close::text AS detail
FROM store.inventory_book
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts', count_ts::text,
       'book_before=' || book_before || ',counted=' || counted || ',adjustment=' || adjustment || ',trigger=' || trigger
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_offs', date::text, units || ' units,' || reason
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'coverage_daily_sales', MIN(date)::text || ' to ' || MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'coverage_pos_lines', MIN(bill_ts)::text || ' to ' || MAX(bill_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'coverage_shelf_audits', MIN(audit_ts)::text || ' to ' || MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.shelf_audits
ORDER BY source, ts;

WITH empty_audits AS (
    SELECT audit_ts::date AS day
    FROM store.shelf_audits
    WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
      AND status = 'empty'
      AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
      AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT e.day,
       d.units_sold,
       d.revenue_inr,
       f.forecast_units_per_day,
       i.book_on_hand_close
FROM empty_audits e
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales d ON d.date = e.day AND d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date = e.day AND f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.date = e.day AND i.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY e.day;

SELECT SUM(units_sold) AS bags_sold,
       SUM(revenue_inr) AS sales_revenue_inr
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND date < DATE '2026-07-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS audits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_shelf_availability_pct
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';
